title: Star Coloring of Hypergraphs
summary: We study a generalization of the star coloring problem on hypergraphs. For a family of connected subhypergraphs $\mathcal{F}$, we define an $\mathcal{F}$-coloring of a hypergraph as a coloring avoiding monochromatic hyperedges and any 2-colored member of $\mathcal{F}$. We let $χ^r_{\mathcal{F}}(d)$ be the maximum of the minimum number of colors needed for an $\mathcal{F}$-coloring of an $r$-uniform hypergraph with maximum degree $d.$ We show bounds for $χ^r_{\mathcal{F}}(d)$, that also yield results on star and acyclic coloring problem on hypergraphs.
